programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Blow
programme.desc: It's a windy day and the Teletubbies collect lots of leaves that have blown off the trees. The leaves go everywhere in Home Dome, so The Noo-­‐noo cleans up.

programme.title: Journey of the Doomed
programme.desc: Journey Of The Doomed stars Tung Wei as a knight that finds himself protecting the life of a beautiful young lady, the lost Emperor's daughter and stalked by a bunch of assassins headed by kung fu actress extraordinaire Hui Ying-Hung.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and after putting Peter through many tests, they finally seal their love with a dance.

programme.title: New Tales of the Flying Fox
programme.desc: In a great rendition of The Silver Fox and Legend of the Fox comes this exciting adventure, where the only thing between the clan leaders and certain death is Hui Ying-hung.

programme.title: Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: A long-awaited horror sequel after Enchanted Shadow, this is about three asylum inmates telling their stories. In story one, a husband and wife discover they should be careful what they wish for. A naked female ghost seeks revenge from her watery grave in story two, and a dead prostitute returns as a ghost in the last tale.

programme.title: Raw Courage
programme.desc: After the Ming Emperor is overthrown and his infant son was put in the care of the Black Dragon Society, a traitorous martial arts clan attacks the society, forcing an inexperienced pair of swordsman and swordswoman to flee with the infant. Their journey to deliver the infant to safety is filled with dangers that would require help from other allies...

programme.title: Opium And The Kung-Fu Master
programme.desc: Tie Qiao San, head of the Ten Guangdong Tigers, is an honourable master with many disciples. As opium becomes popular among the nobles, Tie starts taking it and gradually harms his body. When an opium house's owner defeats Tie in a fight and he is only saved from being killed by his disciple, Tie vows to quit opium and get back on his feet.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: Martial Club
programme.desc: The young Wong Fei Hung and his friend Wang Yin Lin offend the young master of another rival school and the expert they hire, causing both martial arts schools to fight against each other. This is Director Liu Chia Liang's masterpiece and one of the top ten highest grossing movies in 1981.

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the film's hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be applauded by reptile fans everywhere.

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: One-armed Swordsman Fang Kang wants to lead a quiet life with his wife, but when she is abducted by the Eight Demon Swordsmen clan, he is forced to take them on in order to save her.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor student Lin is engaged to the daughter of a rich man who despises him because of his family's declining status. Lin visits his fiancee before leaving for the Imperial examination, but finds a maid lying dead in blood. As Lin's bloody handprint is left on the site, he is accused of the murder. How can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: The Savage Five
programme.desc: A group of bandits flees with a stolen safe to a village where they oppress the villagers and force the blacksmith Wei to unlock the safe. Wei refuses and flees to report to officials, while heroes of the town emerge to fight the bandits.

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: The Mad Monk is up against the equally legendary scholar-turned-genie, Lu Tung Pin. The duo create havoc as they vie with each other, be it in mirth, magic, women or weapons!

programme.title: A Deadly Secret
programme.desc: A corrupt magistrate, obsessed with finding a hidden treasure, jails and tortures his daughter's lover and buries his daughter alive! Ironically, it is in her coffin that the secret to the hidden treasure is found, setting off a frenzy of destruction.

programme.title: Woman of the Night
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him.

programme.title: Woman of the Night
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him.

programme.title: Swift Sword
programme.desc: A righteous swordsman, Bai Yi Pang, seeks revenge on an evil clan but is crippled after being beaten up by them. Years later, a young man encounters Bai who is hiding in a cave. Bai decides to teach this determined young man his Swift Sword skills so that he can help Bai take revenge on the evil clan.

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls' high school, is stuck with a baby that isn't his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by "Drunken Master", this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: Swordswomen Three
programme.desc: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon could be called "Swordswomen Two." Three decades earlier, Shen Yi, Essie Lin Chia, and Pan Ying-tzu took on Shaw's first international superstar, Lo Lieh for the Han Family Sword - making this a four-star treat for action fans.

programme.title: The Lady is the Boss
programme.desc: Wong Hsia Yuan is a traditional kung fu master whose academy is on the brink of closure. Chan Mei Ling arrives from U.S. to revitalize the academy but her way of recruiting students is going beyond questionably legal. Yuan is furious, but when the local triads enter the picture, Yuan and Ling join hands to take back the neighborhood.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: The Imperial Tomb Raiders
programme.desc: The story revolves around a maverick, a band of woman warriors and a group of ruthless bandits. The maverick teams up with the woman warriors to battle the bandits seeking to raid the emperor's tomb.

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed.

programme.title: Two Champions of Shaolin
programme.desc: Set in the Qing Dynasty, the Shaolin clan wants to overthrow Qing and restore the Ming Dynasty, while the Wudang clan is backed by the Qing government. The two renowned clans eventually set themselves up against each other, and a series of vicious fighting has just begun...

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as "City Lights", is the directorwriter's warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles.

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword
programme.desc: Water Clan Chief is severely wounded by a samurai killer shortly before the annual duel at Tai Lake. He sends his brother Bao Yu on a long journey to find an antidote for him. On the way, Bao Yu encounters Little Princess and falls in love with her, not knowing that she is hiding a secret plot...

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The General's henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: The heroine Yu Fei Xia is accused of stealing the book of martial arts secrets. To prove her innocence, she disguises herself as a man and finds her way into the Shaolin Temple to find out the truth...

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fang's fiance and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him...

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fang's fiance and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him...

programme.title: Ghosts Galore
programme.desc: Young Taoist priest Lu and his friend are nearly killed by a female ghost during an exorcism. Luckily, Master Lian saves their lives, so they beseech him to teach them his skills. When his friend is killed by ruthless ninjas, Lu decides to learn the ultimate witchcraft and teams up with his master to defeat them.

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Kuo, a police's son, blames his father for his mother's death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

programme.title: Ode to Gallantry
programme.desc: In this surprisingly light-hearted "Venoms" martial arts adventure, a lone wanderer is repeatedly mistaken for someone else and drawn into a number of violent battles.

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brother's death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death. Bao Zhu grows up to become a skilled swordswoman and meets Liu for the planned duel with her cousin Chen. Can she defeat Liu?

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Hui's husband finds out about them, he hurts Hui and causes her to become seriously ill, while also blackmails Ha. How will this love story end?

programme.title: Crazy Nuts Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: A roadside bandit and a traveling gambler team up to make money from gambling. In a successful attempt to steal a huge amount of money from a warlord's home, they encounter revolutionists who seek their help to fund the reform campaign. Will the two help the revolutionists' cause with the stolen money?

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: The movie consists of four stories of the Mad Monk helping others, from saving a mother and daughter from crumbling walls, to helping hawkers deal with bullies, recovering stolen money for a young man and punishing a devious court official and his son.

programme.title: The Fastest Sword
programme.desc: Southern Swordsman Ting is named "The Fastest Sword" but is defeated by a street monk and has to fulfil his promise of working on stone craving with the monk for three years. Ting returns home to lead a peaceful life after that and declines all fight challenges. Even so, he is forced to fight the Northern Swordsman. Who will win finally?

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the group's drummerleader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummer's mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: Na Cha And The Seven Devils
programme.desc: While stealing one magical peach from a mystic tree in Heaven, Little Na Cha accidentally drops seven others on Earth, which transformed seven different animals into seven devils. Na Cha must hunt the devils down in ten days or his father will be punished by the King of Heaven. Can Na Cha complete his mission?

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: Hong Kong rhapsody is a musical extravaganza full of song and dance! Peter Chen-Ho stars as a playboy magician who changes his ways after he becomes the guardian of a young singer (Li Ching), the daughter of a deceased magician friend.

programme.title: Holy Flame of the Martial World
programme.desc: Yin Tian Chou's parents were killed over a pair of flame-shaped blades. He and his sister were rescued, raised, and trained separately by a hero and a villain, each inheriting one of the blades. Sworn enemies at first, they eventually uncover their true identities and join forces to avenge their parents' deaths.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couple's brothel.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Tristar
programme.desc: Young priest Hong disguises himself to protect Bai, a prostitute, while Detective Liu investigates her ties to a prostitution ring. Hong finds Bai a lawful job and helps her negotiate with the underworld. Meanwhile, Liu's investigation causes misunderstandings - can he crack down on the gang? How will Hong manage his emotions as Bai falls for him?

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur...

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: A Chinese Tall Story
programme.desc: While finding ways to rescue his disciples, Monk Tripitaka meets the lizard imp Mei Yan, the ugliest woman alive. Despite the conflict between good and evil, he falls for Mei Yan who sacrifices herself to save him many times. The Monk breaks his "no killing" rule to save his disciples, and things get more complicated as Princess Galaxy appears...

programme.title: The Myth
programme.desc: An archaeologist Jack, and a scientist William, stumble upon ancient Qin Dynasty artifacts that lead them to the mausoleum and mysteriously connects Jack to his past life as a warrior in ancient China, starting their mythical journey.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Those Were the Days
programme.desc: Director Wong despises Cantonese movies of the 60s, but accidentally travels back in time to that movie set. He meets Director Chu, who tells him he can return to modern time if someone likes the film he makes. Wong meets four classic movie stars and invites them to star in his new film, but it flops unexpectedly. Can Wong return to the present?

programme.title: God of Gambler's Return
programme.desc: The God of Gamblers, Gao Jin, quits gambling and live a quiet life with his wife. However, a Taiwanese crime boss wants to become the new God of Gamblers and get rid of him, so he kills Gao Jin's pregnant wife to force him to the casino table. Gao Jin is indignant and vows to fight the crime boss to avenge his wife's death.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: The Truth: Final Episode
programme.desc: Raymond's lawyer licence is suspended as he has prevented the course of justice to clear his mother's conviction. He is subsequently framed for murder with every piece of evidence pointing towards him. The only one with proof of his innocence is his dying mother, who fights to stay alive long enough to exonerate her son before it is too late.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Ninth Happiness
programme.desc: A comedy starring many popular movie stars, this is a story about a magistrate and his brothers aiming to introduce sin and romance into the virtuous community of Rainbow Village. As they vie for the affections of a charming young village maiden, conflicts arise, adding a twist to their mischievous endeavours.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation...

programme.title: Midnight Fly
programme.desc: With her marriage in crisis, Michele takes off to Europe for a vacation and meets a Japanese woman named Miki. As they become friends and travel together, Michele discovers that Miki is her husband's mistress. When Miki goes missing in Morocco, Michele does everything she can to find her but ends up paying a heavy price...

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Long Arm of the Law Part 3
programme.desc: Chinese ex-soldier Li is wrongly accused and seeks refuge in Hong Kong to escape a death sentence. En route, he meets Sam and Moon. While Li has fallen in love with Moon, Hong Kong triad kidnaps Moon and coerces Li into aiding a robbery. Meanwhile, the mainland police officer tracks Li's path to Hong Kong, intensifying the chase.

programme.title: The Phantom Lover
programme.desc: In 1926 China, Sung, a talented singer, is deeply in love with To, a sweet innocent girl from a wealthy family. Their love evokes strong disapproval from To's father and bitter jealousy from her designated fiance, a young man chosen by her family. This is a story about a singer and a wealthy girl battling to be together in a traditional community.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find "The Sutra of 42 Chapters". Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: It's a Wonderful Life
programme.desc: Hong Kong tycoon Ren Da Kuan takes care of his family that spans four generations, yet his three sons grapple with their own challenges. Everything changes when his daughter returns from studying in France with her friend Roberto. Roberto brings a wave of transformation to the Ren family, sparking new hope and opportunities for all.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Wo Hu
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Police has placed more than a thousand undercover officers in various triad groups to bring down the largest criminal organization in Hong Kong. Betrayal, deceit and murder bring this group of "brothers" into a collision with the law and with each other!

programme.title: The Chinese Feast
programme.desc: Sun wants to start a new life as a chef in Canada and struggles to learn cooking skills from a restaurant owner, Au. While Sun will represent his restaurant to participate in a cooking competition, his skill is not good enough, and he has to seek help from a legendary master chef in order to win the ultimate challenge.

programme.title: Bullet and Brain
programme.desc: Nine years ago, two legendary criminals, Bullet and Brain, vowed not to kill and lie before they disappeared. Both now return for a mission - to protect the granddaughter of the triad boss. Can they succeed without breaking their vows?

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong's biggest stars

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair
programme.desc: As Wudang disciple Zhuo Yi Hang confronts the Demon Palace, he reunites with Lian Ni Shang, the woman who once saved him, and their love reignites. Lian, a disciple of the Demon Palace, endures torment to be with Zhuo but is shattered when he accidentally injures her. A fierce battle between good and evil unfolds!

programme.title: PTU
programme.desc: When OCTB (Organized Crime And Triad Bureau) officer, Sergeant Lo Sa, loses his police revolver to four triad young thugs, he seeks help from Sergeant Mike Ho of the PTU (Police Tactical Unit) to find his lost revolver. Ho and his patrolling PTU team has until dawn to recover the gun and clean up the mess.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Beauty And The 7 Beasts
programme.desc: Teddy, once a renowned movie star, is facing a career decline. To make a living, he accepts five disciples to shape them into stars. Teddy's career regains momentum after he reunites with his long-lost daughter, but he is also confronted by a rival at the same time. His daughter and disciples decide to help him overcome this difficult situation...

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well (Extended Version)
programme.desc: In this beloved Hong Kong comedy, the three Chang brothers living with their parents learn that love blossoms with nurture, but withers when taken for granted through haste, deceit, and selfishness. This extended version features an additional shootout scene that was omitted from the original theatrical release during Lunar New Year 2016.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well Too
programme.desc: Another super comedy directed by Clifton Ko about more farcical couplings, mistaken identities, infidelities, and arranged marriages set in the Sung Dynasty.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Love For All Seasons
programme.desc: May, acting leader of the Er Mei sect, cures the incurable illness of Tiger, a rich playboy. Under the threat of her senior, May seeks help from Tiger to experience heartbreak and master the "Heartbroken Sword" style, so as to defeat her senior and preserve Er Mei sect. Will this strange and long-winding relationship reach a happy ending?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S2 - Baddie Issues
programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! The adventures lead them to London, where they are wanted by the Knights. Old enemies resurface and Blade will have to face one of her most challenging opponents-her mom.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S2 - A Family Friend
programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! The adventures lead them to London, where they are wanted by the Knights. Old enemies resurface and Blade will have to face one of her most challenging opponents-her mom.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Becoming Part 1
programme.desc: An average high school student, Jim Lake, yearns for adventure and he gets more than he bargained for when he inherits the mantle of Trollhunter after the previous Trollhunter is killed

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Becoming Part 2
programme.desc: Jim warms up to the idea of being the Trollhunter until he faces Bular, who is determined to destroy him, so he seeks help in Blinky and AAARRRGGHH!!

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Wherefore Art Thou Trollhunter?
programme.desc: Jim is not welcomed by the Trolls as their new Trollhunter, and he suffers a humiliating defeat at the hands of Draal

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Spaceship
programme.desc: The dollhouse delivery is a spaceship that takes off with a sleeping CatRat inside! Gabby, Pandy, and Kitty Fairy have to get the ship back into The Fairy Tail Garden before Floyd (who thinks it's the best kitty toy ever!) gets his paws on it!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Gabby Gets The Hiccups
programme.desc: The dollhouse delivery is a cat-in-the-box that startles Gabby, giving her the hiccups. Dr. Pandy and the Gabby Cats try several cures, but it isn't until CatRat scares the hiccups out of Gabby that they go away!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Hamster Kitties
programme.desc: When 6 adorable hamster kitties get loose in the dollhouse, Gabby, Pandy and Baby Box head out to look for them. Along the way, Baby Box learns a lot about hamster kitties, which convinces Mama Box to let them live in the Craft Room.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty School
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a school notebook and lunch box, it's Kitty School Day in the dollhouse! Gabby and Pandy head to different classes held by the Gabby Cats to learn and live a day in the life of a student.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Cat Cam
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a new camera that takes pictures with silly filters, CatRat uses it to lead Gabby, Pandy, and the Gabby Cats on a photographic scavenger hunt around the dollhouse!

programme.title: The Adventures Of Rocky And Bullwinkle S1 - Stink of Fear: Chapter One
programme.desc: When Rocky and Bullwinkle travel to Paris to enter a cooking competition, Fearless Leader sends super spies Boris and Natasha after Bullwinkle to steal his secret recipe

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - How Do We Make A Boat?
programme.desc: Jess and Horace want to play Boat Racing on the pond - but first the need work out how to make a boat! Some things are too heavy, some are too light… having tried lots of options and worked out that they need something light and boat shaped, they make Mimi's paper hats into boats for their boat race. Perfect!

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - How Can We All Keep Warm?
programme.desc: It's Willow's apple picking party today, but some of the friends just are too chilly to go. Jess tries to work out how to keep them all warm, should they cover themselves in mud just like frogs do? Should they wrap themselves up in straw? Or might running around be the trick to getting them all toasty warm?

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - What's Happened To Chloe The Caterpillar?
programme.desc: Jess wants to introduce Willow to his new friend, Chloe the caterpillar. But where's Chloe gone? He searches for her in all the places she might be, where he's visited her before, where there might be juicey leaves she'd like to eat but it's not until a butterfly breaks out of a little Chloe-shaped-sack that Jess realises that Chloe's just changed!

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - When Will My Coloured Stripes Come Back?
programme.desc: Jess is playing puddle jumping, dodging the rain to have fun on a gloomy day when suddenly, just as the rain's stopping, the sun comes out and at the same time he sees a beautiful rainbow in the sky. He's desperate to show his friends, and it's not until he works out you need sunshine and rain at the same time to make a rainbow that he can show his friends the beautiful coloured shape in the sky.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - Who Did I Hear In The Big Hollow Log?
programme.desc: Jess is searching for Horace by the pond but he's nowhere to be found. When he calls into a hollow log and his voice echo's back, Jess thinks it's the voice of a new friend and sets about trying to work out where the friend is. By using comparisons and clever thinking, Jess works out that it's not someone else - it's his voice bouncing off the log. It's an echo,

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - What Can We Do With Mimi's Rubbish?
programme.desc: Jess is off to play painting and gluing with his pink rabbit friend Mimi. He's very excited. But when he arrives Mimi's hutch is overflowing with rubbish and there's no space for their art project. Jess works out how to get the rubbish out of the hutch using recyclling re-using and re-pairing.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S1 - Bully For You The Ra Animator
programme.desc: Bully For You When Casper decides he can't take any more of Thatch's nastiness, he forms a secret squad dedicated to putting an end to bullying. The Ra-minator Using the power of invisibility, Casper offers to help transform Ra from a sports zero to an athletic hero.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S1 - Weekend At Bunny's Grimly Day
programme.desc: Weekend at Bunny's Alder and Dash sound the alarm after a terrifying creature threatens Scare School. Grimly Day It's Grimly Day?the grimmest day of the year!

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Boo to You
programme.desc: Burple gets spooked by the legend of a ghost called the Phantom Fang. But when he senses the story is real, he can't get his friends to believe him.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Where There's Smoke
programme.desc: After Magnus accuses Cutter of setting fires near the village that could hurt the sheep, the Riders have to put them out and find the real culprit.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - It's A Secret Queen Of Thighs
programme.desc: Oh cannot keep a secret when Tip tells him she's planning a surprise partyLucy's "Queen of Thighs" video goes viral and turns her into a celebrity.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Krunkle Krush Beauty Tip
programme.desc: Tip spies on Oh when he has his first date with a strange Boov named Krunkle.Tip competes against rival Pom Pom Pappernacky in a beauty pageant.

programme.title: Harvey Girls Forever! S1 - Harveyween New Kid on the Block
programme.desc: Lotta has to save her friends while overcoming her fear of "Nighttime Halloween". The girls do their best to make the new kid on the block fall in love with Harvey Street.

programme.title: Harvey Girls Forever! S1 - FruLess Citizen Cape
programme.desc: The Harvey Girls set off to help unfriendly Frufru make friends in time birthday party! Dot gets a little carried away after starting a fashion-forward cape business.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Little Sisters Tricky Treasure
programme.desc: Kelp and Pixie forget about their little sisters and their plans to hang out. Scallop goes to Unicorn Land and meets Juniper. They play and become friends. The unicorns are eager to play with a new mystery item that washes up on the beach, but what is it? While the other unicorns come up with imaginative ideas of what it could be, Pixie is determined to find out exactly what it is.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Crabby Spe-shell
programme.desc: When Pixie’s pet crab goes into a cave, Kelp uses his knowledge of crabs under the sea to coax him out using dance and rhythm. Scallop’s special shell is broken, but Kelp transforms the broken bits into something even more special.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Old Dog, New Tricks \ Snoozie-Hullabaloozie
programme.desc: Tag chooses to pair up with her Grandpaw for the Barker Family Talent Show, and together, they search for their winning talent. \ Tag is surprised to learn that today is the Pawston Snoozie-a-Hullabaloozie. With everything shut down for the day, Tag and Scooch take the opportunity to play all over town, while trying not to wake up other dogs.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Show Dog, Show \ Keys to Victory
programme.desc: Tag can't wait to show off her car at the car show. But when Cheddar Biscuit wants to come along and pick up her clown friends along the way, Tag is wary that Cheddar Biscuit will steal her thunder. \ The Not Yet Cadets can't wait to watch Sam’s big race. But when Sam loses his car key, he challenges the Not Yet Cadets to race around town to find it.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - You (Don't) Snooze, You Lose Save The Squasher
programme.desc: When the crew takes on a mission to help Ian get some rest for a Badminton Tournament, Jax realises that the biggest approach isn't always the best approach. When Lula loses her comic book, Ari learns that the best heroes rely on teamwork and not gadgets.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Gopher it! A Glamping We Will Go
programme.desc: When a pesky gopher gets in the way of Fawna making her famous veggie stew, Niah learns to not let a bad experience, get in the way of doing good. When the inexperienced Rona has to step in for Donna, the team makes sure everyone has the best camping trip ever.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Banana Bread Burglar Finding Meow Meow
programme.desc: When the banana bread Harper leaves out for Eden is stolen, the Dew Drops create a sting operation to catch the thief. programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Catch that Drone The Fairy of the Teeth

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - Wet Hot Ahhh Valley Summer Grug Vs The Moon

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - This Means Warts

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - The Coo Chi Coup

programme.desc: Jess wants the puppies to come Puddle Jumping with him. There were lots of puddles the day before but when they get to the spot, the puddle's GONE! Jess goes searching - has someone taken it? Borrowed it? No, he works out that the water's gone back up in to the clouds.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - Why Has My Shadow Gone Away?
programme.desc: Jess has s new friend - Horace tells him it's his shadow. Jess is keen to introduce him to all his friends, but he keeps running away! Jess works out that the sun has to be shining for the shadow to come back and that all the friends have their Own shadows to play games with too.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - When Will The Water Come Back?
programme.desc: Jess is concerned that all the water on the farm is frozen and sets about working out when it will come back. He works out that once the sun is out the ice melts and learns all about freezing and melting..

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - How Can We Paint The Lilly Pad Green?
programme.desc: Mimi is trying to prepare for a visit from Horace and wants the hutch to feel like home for her froggy friend. Jess promises to paint the special seat Mimi has made for Horace green for her, but first he has to work out how to make green from different colours.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S1 - Scare Scouts Boo
programme.desc: Scare Scouts When Frankengymteacher forms a scout troop, Casper is the first to sign up. Boo! During a visit to Deedstown, Casper and his friends are shocked to find the humans dressed as scary creatures…it must Halloween!

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S1 - Abra-Ca-Deedstown Shrinky Dust
programme.desc: Abra-Ca-Deedstown From cleaning Ra's sarcophagus, to starring in Jimmy's magic act, Casper has been helping so much, he's exhausted. Shrinky Dust When magical Shrinky Dust falls into Norman the bully's hands, Casper and Jimmy find themselves on a hunt to get it back.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Sick Day
programme.desc: When the other dragons come down with the flu, Summer must overcome her fear of eels to retrieve the cure and get her friends back in the air.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Bad Egg
programme.desc: Magnus hatches a plan to hide in an egg to spy on the Rescue Riders. But things get all scrambled when a mama dragon takes him to her nest.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - The Gray Matter Fever Break
programme.desc: Oh and Tip discover an underground cult living in the sewers.While Tip is home with a fever, she witnesses a crime committed by her scheming neighbor, Donny.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Wrinkly Humans People Piggy Piggy
programme.desc: Tip doesn't think her grandparents will approve of Oh so he disguises himself as a humans housekeeperSharzod adopts Pig and names him "Juicy Booty."

programme.title: Harvey Girls Forever! S1 - Campfire Weekend Girls Just Wanna Save Fun
programme.desc: When the girls can’t go to camp they create their very own on Harvey street. The story of how Audrey, Dot and Lotta first became the Harvey Girls.

programme.title: Harvey Girls Forever! S1 - A Matter of Life and BFF Cheer and Present Danger
programme.desc: After her friendship bracelet breaks, Lotta does everything she can to keep her friends. With the holidays months away the girls create their own- Friendship Appreciation Day!

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Mom’s Birthday Angry
programme.desc: Kelp and Scallop enlist Cruz’s help to perform a dance for Mom’s birthday. Though it’s hard at first, they learn to put their dolphin, unicorn, and narwhal powers together to create something special. Kelp, Pixie, Ollie, and their friend Leroy try to help Juniper understand her angry feelings.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Tuskist Three Moon Festival
programme.desc: Scallop is afraid of her first "tuskist" appointment. Kelp helps her get through it with a song. Fog rolls in, threatening Kelp’s first Three Moon Festival in Unicorn Land. Kelp and his friends use a combination of unicorn spark and the Kelp Way to create a new festival.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Ding Dong Day \ Grand Sam
programme.desc: It’s Pawston’s annual Take Your Kid to Work Day, and it’s Tag’s year to spend the day at the Doorbell Store with Paw. \ Sam Whippet challenges the Not Yet Cadets to complete an obstacle course in the woods.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Clucky Day \ Take Me Out to the Fetch Game
programme.desc: Scooch is bummed out because he’s missing his favorite holiday back in his old farm town, so Tag wants to cheer him up by rounding up some chickens and bringing Clucky Day to Pawston. \ When there’s a schedule mix-up and the Pawston Get Sox players think they have a day off, it’s up to Tag and Scooch to round up all five players in time for the fetch game, so that they don’t have to forfeit.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Pet Project Mission Improbable
programme.desc: When Mr. Tanaka adopts an unruly dog at Sam’s behest, the Zenkos have the job of training the mischievous mutt and turning him into man’s best friend material. When Ellie's friend Maria is late submitting her painting to the art show, it’s up to the Zenkos to get inside the community center after hours, avoiding overzealous junior security Rodney, and get Maria’s painting on display before the show starts.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - An Inconvenient Tooth Up, Up and Away
programme.desc: After Lula loses her loose tooth in the park, Team Zenko must find the missing molar and get it under Lula’s pillow in time for the Tooth Fairy’s visit. Gabriel and Luis show off their new drone but it crash lands on the roof top. Team Zenko's mission is to try and get it back, but Yolanda won't give up her new hi-tech friend that easily.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Mailed Away The Wandering Wand
programme.desc: When Harper unknowingly drops her cooking camp application on the way to post office, it’s up to the Dew Drops to get it into that big blue mailbox. When Cassie accidentally places Lola's beloved, old toy wand in a box marked for a giveaway drive in the park, the Dew Drops must find a way to retrieve the wand before it ends up in the hands of an entirely new family.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Lucky Penny Hammy’s Day Out
programme.desc: Marcus has a piano recital and unknowingly forgets his lucky penny at home. Now it’s up to the Dew Drops to get the penny across town and back into Marcus’ pocket before showtime. When Nicholas rolls the hamster ball (with Hammy inside) out into the streets, the Dew Drops must get Hammy back home safely.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - Eep-Over Thunkytown
programme.desc: When Eep has the first-ever sleepover, scary noises and shadows send the girls screaming out of the cave; Thunk saves the day when Bear Owls invade.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - Mom Genes
programme.desc: When Grug takes Ugga hunting to find her inner growl again, she's as fierce as ever until coming face-to-face with a mom and baby too cute to catch.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Escape From Krinkle's
programme.desc: Boss has an opportunity to get his old job back at Baby Corp;but to get the interview;he’ll need the playgroup babies to help him escape Marsha Krinkle’s super-safe Bubbeezee playroom. Tim nearly misses Kabob Day at school.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Puppy Party!
programme.desc: Boss comes face to face with his old nemesis;Bug The Pug;after the playgroup parents decide to throw a Puppy Party. Staci creates a "No-Paperworkist" movement to avoid Buddy From HR’s constant paperwork.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S3 - Dawn Of Destruction
programme.desc: When Hiccup and Astrid go away for a weekend, the Edge is attacked by Krogan, Viggo, and their new Dragon Flyers

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S3 - The Wings Of War Part 1
programme.desc: Hiccup and the riders are on the run from the Flyers, but when they return to Berk, where Stoick is preparing for war, Hiccup is torn between his desire to get the Edge back and his unwillingness to fire on dragons

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Mixed-Up Dollhouse
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a snow globe shaped like the dollhouse, she notices the rooms inside are all cattywampus and in the wrong place. After a series of wacky misadventures that result in CatRat becoming a craft version of himself, Gabby figures out they need to fix the dollhouse globe to return everything back to normal.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Game Show
programme.desc: It’s Game Show Day in the dollhouse! Our wily and well-groomed host, CatRat, leads Gabby and Pandy around the dollhouse, where they compete in Gab-ified games, like Tushy Tunes on the "butt xylophone" couch and a cooking competition of Bakey with Cakey. They win tickets and trade them in for prizes at the end.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Flustering Mindless Woe of the Flushable Memory Wipes
programme.desc: After being made fun of for sitting in chocolate pudding, George and Harold go into hiding only to come back to find that everybody has forgotten who they are

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Soggy Salvation of the Swirling Sweatnami
programme.desc: Tired of mean Mr. Krupp, the boys go back in time to prevent him from becoming a bully, but discover that their plan has backfired when they return to the present

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Sickening Fumes of Smartsy Fartsy
programme.desc: In order to retrieve Mr. Krupp’s locked up rule book, George and Harold use an invention that ends up turning against them

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S2 - The Battle of Tianshang Part 1
programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! The adventures lead them to London, where they are wanted by the Knights. Old enemies resurface and Blade will have to face one of her most challenging opponents-her mom.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Halloween
programme.desc: Boss Baby uses the cover of Halloween Night to sneak into Bubeezee’s Headquarters to shut it all down. Tim covers for Boss by distracting Marisol with a night of trick or treating.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Who's a Good Baby?
programme.desc: A brainwashed Boss Baby breaks free from overly sanitized Bubbeezee products. He rallies the Playgroup Babies to run the company out of business by breaking every product in town.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Yellow 100
programme.desc: Finally promoted to CEO, Boss Baby sets his sights on achieving 100% Baby Love, while dealing with the annoying Puppies and Preeks who rented Baby Corp office space while Boss was gone. Tim and Danny become local heroes after saving a baby's life.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Riding Academy S3 - Welcome Back Otter
programme.desc: Abigail puts herself at risk to reunite an orphaned otter with his family. But the school veterinarian insists the animal will be safer at the zoo.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Riding Academy S3 - The Palomino Family Affair
programme.desc: Lucky and Bebe spend the weekend pretending to be besties when their fathers come for a family visit and reveal that they're old friends.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Riding Academy S3 - Back To The Starting Line
programme.desc: As a new term begins, Maricela and her horse, Mystery, arrive at the academy to join Lucky, Pru and Abigail for the school year.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - Night Of The Living Croods Spoonful Of Soo-Gar
programme.desc: When The Croods experience the first-ever sugar-rush, they're hooked on the delicious new food; Grug is labeled a zombie after taking the first nap.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - Friday Night Liyotes
programme.desc: When Grug won't let her join his winning team, Eep forms her own underdog team in the first-ever sports competition - Ahhh! Valley's annual Egg Toss.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - The Crood Who Knew Too Much Scent Of A Thunk
programme.desc: When Thunk is so stinky he kills animals with his stench, he pretends to be a great hunter; A spider ant bite gives Grug the biggest brain in town.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S3 - Snuffnut
programme.desc: Tuff fakes his own death to make room for Throk, but when Ruff tries to train the Changewing that she thinks ate Tuff, a flock of angry Changewings come for the dragon

programme.desc: On a search for Dagur's dad, Hiccup and Dagur encounter vicious Grim Gnashers, and Tuff's search for a missing Chicken leads him to discover she has a second family

programme.title: Gods Of Honour - EP36
programme.desc: NAR JAR (CHAN HO MAN, BENNY) was a ‘Fire master’ in his previous life. He was killed by LEE CHING (YUEN WAH). After reincarnation, he ironically becomes CHING’s third son. He is very much affected by his old memories and cannot forgive his father. CHING also keeps his distance from him because of his exotic nature and eventually sends him away with excuses. Luckily, he is saved by some kind people and becomes a General when he is still a teenager.

programme.title: L'Escargot - EP5
programme.desc: Renovation contractor KWAN KA-ON (Miu Kiu Wai) is the elder of four siblings, while his wife SZE LONG-KIU (Sonija Kwok) is a typical housewife. Buying a house is their longtime dream. But when his eldest brother, KWAN KA-HONG’s business goes under, they shelve their plan to help him overcome his difficulties. KIU has to look for a job too.

programme.title: I've Got The Power - EP21
programme.desc: Chung Hau-nin (Ruco Chan), Kiu Yeuk-lam (Natalie Tong) and Ko Yung (Joel Chan) are complete strangers. After surviving a traffic accident, they astonishingly gain mystical power!_x000D__x000D_Hau-nin and Ding Shuk-man (Moon Lau) are a loving young married couple. Hau-nin intends to use his mystical power for his own benefit, but he knows how to use his mystical power to help other people as he is influenced by Yeuk-lam, who has a righteous character.

programme.title: A STEP INTO THE PAST - EP2
programme.desc: HONG SHIU LUNG (KOO TIN LOK, LOUIS) is an secret agent in the 21st Century. He joins a pilot programme to fly back in time hoping that he will salvage his unforgettable love. However, something goes wrong during the mission. He is sent back to the Warring States Period. Emperor QI (LAM RAYMOND) has not been crowned yet and is kept hostage in Chiu. In order to return to the future, LUNG decides to help QI become emperor. With his wisdom and Kungfu, he is recognized and given important tasks.

programme.title: At The Threshold Of An Era - EP50
programme.desc: The property giant YIP WING TIM (Lo Ka Leung, Gallen) was born in the 60’s in Hong Kong. His father, honest and righteous, was betrayed by his brother and put into prison. TIM, therefore, learned to be wise. He tried all means to take revenge and fortune seeking was always on top of his priorities. With the help from his best friend MA CHI KEUNG (Kwok Chun On), TIM took over an incomplete village housing development.

programme.title: 说人解字第14集

programme.title: 阎小妹第45集
programme.desc: 这是一座介于乡村与都市间的迷你化、可爱化的小城镇-东閰镇。里面住著许多东方传说中的人物、妖怪以及拟人化的动物。故事主人翁閰小妹是东閰镇镇长的独生女，就读东閰国小三年级，班上有各式各样的妖怪同学，还有一位来自西方的留学生迪米欧。迪米欧和閰小妹两人成为一对有趣的搭档，产生出许多好玩的趣事。在东閰镇里，每天可以认识许多稀奇古怪的妖怪，每个角落都有著新奇有趣的故事等待被发掘。閰小妹将带领著迪米欧与同学们在东閰城里一起学习、一起探险，也将引导观众，重新认识华人文化里，最具奇幻魅力的异想世界。

programme.desc: 以100多位历史人物为主题，共说了近400则的成语故事，这些耳熟能详的成语，出自数百年甚至是千年前，包括孔孟老庄、李白、杜甫、曹操、刘备……等上百位真实的、虚构的人物。以特有的说书方式，讲述这些人的生平以及相关成语典故，轻松逗趣却又寓意深远。

programme.title: 遇见一首诗第32集
programme.desc: 寻找一首诗，遇见一首诗，在爱的热望里，在典范的仰望下，在社会关怀的悲悯叹息声中。诗人教授带你品读，进入现代诗的迷人世界。

programme.title: 生活快易通第10集
programme.desc: 节目邀请到大家熟悉的「万人美老师」－郭昱晴担任主持人。以系列为节目核心，邀请在相同体系内，受到推崇的精英人士，分享其坚守追求专业的精神与受挫不懈的毅力。并且将依照不同专业，结合生活观点，推出相符的小单元。内容兼具权威与风趣，不仅拉近观众与来宾距离，也从中看到来宾不为人知的另一面。如节目中热血仁医系列，除了分享医生在白色巨塔中奋斗的故事之外，也会依其专业，在预防医学的概念下，加入医疗科技新资讯及独门养生撇步等小单元。

programme.title: 梵音清流第2集
programme.desc: 此音只应天上有，人间哪得几回闻。」「梵呗」就是清净之意，除了耳根享受之外，最主要的仍在心灵的清净，歌咏时还伴以管、弦或敲击乐器，普及佛教教义。

programme.title: 阎小妹第45集
programme.desc: 这是一座介于乡村与都市间的迷你化、可爱化的小城镇-东閰镇。里面住著许多东方传说中的人物、妖怪以及拟人化的动物。故事主人翁閰小妹是东閰镇镇长的独生女，就读东閰国小三年级，班上有各式各样的妖怪同学，还有一位来自西方的留学生迪米欧。迪米欧和閰小妹两人成为一对有趣的搭档，产生出许多好玩的趣事。在东閰镇里，每天可以认识许多稀奇古怪的妖怪，每个角落都有著新奇有趣的故事等待被发掘。閰小妹将带领著迪米欧与同学们在东閰城里一起学习、一起探险，也将引导观众，重新认识华人文化里，最具奇幻魅力的异想世界。

programme.title: 人间新闻
programme.desc: 人间卫视不同于其他电视台定位，一向致力于打造媒体新视野，并期许为新闻界注入一股清流。《人间新闻》此次改版，将再提升新闻品质与水准，落实公益电视台的媒体责任。《人间新闻》报导的焦点包含慈善公益、社会关怀、文化艺术、人文教育、心灵提升、健康医疗、环保议题等内容，借由这些新闻与专题报导，将传递真善美的人间清流，提供观众更广阔的新闻视野，与世界脉动接轨。

programme.title: 生活智多星第1664集
programme.desc: 人间卫视【生活智多星】邀请到「好门媳妇」－郁方担任主持人，透过轻松活泼的访谈，让您成为生活上「智多星」。本节目邀请不同领域的专家学者，从科学的观点，深入浅出地剖析生活大小事。打破您心中的疑虑与似是而非的伪知识，了解事情的源由与真相，提供不一样的想法与见解。【生活智多星】内容丰富多元，例如针对银发族的需求，邀请银发族运动专家，将因久坐而气滞血瘀的沙发马铃薯大变身，强力打造出活力四射、充满元气的不老传说。以及有关吃的大哉问：吃进嘴里的是营养还是毒药，吃的顺序、吃的方法与吃的健康，从不吃坏肚子到吃到强身健体，【生活智多星】全面关心。

programme.desc: 由人气主持人携手多位蔬食名厨，现场烹调精致美味的蔬食餐点，让您大饱眼福，也大饱口福。

programme.title: 阿母第33集
programme.desc: 母亲简称母，或称妈妈，是一种亲属关系的称谓，是子女对双亲中的女性的称呼。母亲和子女是重要的直系亲属关系之一，通常具有亲密关系。一般指生育小孩的女人（即生母）；但在有些状况下，仅养育小孩（养母），或再婚配偶（继母）、结谊长辈（义母），或是仅提供卵子让精子与之结合（代孕母）（例如捐卵等辅助生殖技术），但并未亲自生育小孩的女人也可如此称呼。

programme.title: 宝岛西米乐守护第155集
programme.desc: 热闹的台北太平老街上，少女春燕和母亲雅芬穿过拥挤的人群，来到生意兴隆、美军也来光顾的「宝岛西服店」，寻找失踪的父亲照清。照清曾在这里当过学徒，和老板梅树师是师兄弟，但因故未能出师…。春燕看著梅树与晓兰鹣鲽情深地经营「宝岛西服店」，这美好的景象让春燕想起父亲曾向自己承诺，未来若跟著师兄梅树出师后，自己的西服店也会正式挂牌营业，并收女儿春燕当全台第一位西装女徒弟，将西装技艺传承下去

programme.title: 美丽人生壮志高飞第393集
programme.desc: 台视60周年台庆大戏《美丽人生》第五单元《壮志高飞》，以1960年代高雄市旗津岛为故事起点，三位最美丽的台湾女人，在台湾最美丽的年代，在最美丽的旗津，悲欢交织而成的美丽人生。数百年前，旗津还没有一个统一的名称，岛的南端依旧与高雄相连。 而后，为了建造高雄港第二港口，旗津南端名唤『崩隙』的这片沙土挖空了，居民被迫迁移，旗津也因而断开 了与台湾的连系，犹如游子，离开了母亲的怀抱。土地会消失，历史也许会被淡忘，但曾经走过那段艰辛岁月的人们，他们的悲欢离合、笑容与泪水，仍将会转化为孕育后代子孙的养分，开出灿烂的花朵。这是属于我们上一代人的故事，也是我们这一代人的故事，是所有在这座岛屿上奋斗的人们的—《

programme.title: 阿母第34集
programme.desc: 母亲简称母，或称妈妈，是一种亲属关系的称谓，是子女对双亲中的女性的称呼。母亲和子女是重要的直系亲属关系之一，通常具有亲密关系。一般指生育小孩的女人（即生母）；但在有些状况下，仅养育小孩（养母），或再婚配偶（继母）、结谊长辈（义母），或是仅提供卵子让精子与之结合（代孕母）（例如捐卵等辅助生殖技术），但并未亲自生育小孩的女人也可如此称呼。

programme.title: 烤箱读书会第15集
programme.desc: 为提倡亲子共读、快乐阅读，全新打造专属节目《烤箱读书会》！日本国际儿童图书评议会主席松居直先生说：「阅读应该是一件快乐的事！」。不管大人或小孩，每个人都喜欢做有趣的事，如果能将阅­读和有趣的事结合在一起，应该就能创造充满趣味的阅读经验，在这个节目当中，将带领小朋友动手做点心，利用烘焙时间，和他们共读一本图画书，不仅分享故事，还有动听的诗­歌，让更多大小朋友透过电视，共同参与这个充满乐趣又有益身心的阅读活动。

programme.title: 葬送的芙莉莲第20集
programme.desc: 魔法使芙莉莲与勇者欣梅尔等人一同经历了10年的冒险，最终打倒魔王，替世界带来了和平。芙莉莲身为活了千年以上的精灵，她与欣梅尔等人约好再次相会后，便独自踏上旅程。在那之后过了50年，芙莉莲造访欣梅尔的所在地，但她与50年前长得一模一样，相较之下欣梅尔已经老去，早已时日无多。之后，芙莉莲亲眼见到过世的欣梅尔，深深体悟自己至今都没有去「了解他人」，对此感到懊悔的她，决定「为了了解他人」而踏上旅程。

programme.title: 大爱年度剧展-芳草碧连天第1集
programme.desc: 这是台湾三代女性传承孝顺的历史缩影。 魏家三代女性的心路历程，从第一代阿罔，在艰困的环境中，没有失志，奋发面对生活的挑战，孝顺婆婆、支持丈夫及女儿，让大家都能好好活下去，与人为善，救贫治病，深受四邻亲友敬仰的精神里，影响著女儿高金英及孙女杏芬杏娟姊妹，他们传承阿妈的脚步，走过时代洪流，与家人彼此扶持，以孝顺回报阿妈和母亲。杏芬在美国听了「渡」的录音带把家人都度进慈济

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第3集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 志为人医守护爱2.0第175集
programme.desc:
什么是有温度的医疗？什么是医疗之魂？医疗团队除了在诊间、在手术室、在病房抢救生命之外，还能做些什么？
『志为人医守护爱』带您目击动人的温馨医病情现场，透过医疗团队的视病如亲、 以病为师的坚持、病患与医疗团队的互相感恩，体会与感受现代人医如何帮助病患重拾信心，在他们人生低潮时重新出发，进而走入人群，自助助人。

programme.title: 法华经序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法华经序系花莲静思精舍，于每日拂晓时分，僧俗二众的早课实录，意在启发自性本具的大乘精神；旨于引导大众常行菩萨道。除心无旁骛专注于当下课诵的经文外，同时扩及日常生活每一刻的专注、培养慈悲佛心，学习缩小自我，破我执，达到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 行动现场第545集
programme.desc:
爱，不漏接，做，就对了！
台湾社会贫富悬殊、强弱失衡，现有政策与资源难以弭平，在国家发展到了一定程度后，最终希望世界大同、人人平等，迈向福利理想国，但社福法规、人力、经费及各方资源都不足分配，无法周全，得靠民间力量自我体现，多少填补缺口。慈济志工为数甚众，是台湾最有组织与规模的NGO，借由众多的人间菩萨散布各乡镇村里，或许能照顾到乏人闻问的黯淡角落。

programme.desc: 这是台湾三代女性传承孝顺的历史缩影。 魏家三代女性的心路历程，从第一代阿罔，在艰困的环境中，没有失志，奋发面对生活的挑战，孝顺婆婆、支持丈夫及女儿，让大家都能好好活下去，与人为善，救贫治病，深受四邻亲友敬仰的精神里，影响著女儿高金英及孙女杏芬杏娟姊妹，他们传承阿妈的脚步，走过时代洪流，与家人彼此扶持，以孝顺回报阿妈和母亲。杏芬在美国听了「渡」的录音带把家人都度进慈济

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第38集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 仁心慧语第619集
programme.desc: 真正的智慧来自于内心，由内心启悟的智慧也最真实。证严 上人说：「做该做的事就是智慧，做不该做的事就是愚痴。」十个问题、十个解方，都是言者生命经验的体现，透过名人的智慧哲理，足以启迪人心，振聋发瞆，重新思考人生的价值。

programme.title: MIT台湾志第591集
programme.desc: 《MIT台湾志》是为台湾探访与见证前人留下历史足迹，为台湾这块土地留下一段完整纪录，并参照资料照片与麦觉明口头解说，令观众可以拼凑出当年历史。在每段广告之前，《MIT台湾志》会出现一则专题解说，是《MIT台湾志》另一项特色。《MIT台湾志》除富有历史文化探访纪录外，在探访路途上会不断探究与发现值得纪录之事，有：生态介绍、地质变化、新物种发现、辨认动植物、山岳特色与气候、术语解说、人文风情写实…等，这也见证了台湾前古后今、探史溯源的多元性纪录，是一部具有生态教学、文化品味、社会动态与价值变化的诠释，深深结合自台湾有开发历史以来，历经沧海桑田的岁月与战争留下的烙痕。

programme.desc: 故事讲述一个在台湾北漂的家庭，浪漫天真的父亲不切实际地为这个家带来债务、困扰与纷争。时常失踪的父亲只能由任劳任怨的母亲咬牙把这个家支撑下去。多年后四处飘浪的父亲癌末回来找长大后的女儿，女儿为了处理父亲的临终把本已瓦解的家庭关系，再次找回分散各地家人，并在父亲临终前相互道歉、和解道别。

programme.title: 三生三世十里桃花第27集
programme.desc: 同名小说改编。青丘九尾狐族女君白浅（杨幂）为四海八荒第一绝色，化名司音拜入战神墨渊（赵又廷）门下，因而卷入天族与翼族之战。在墨渊封印东皇钟七万年后，白浅代师再次封印东皇钟而受伤，失去记忆与修为落入凡尘历劫，却因此变成凡人素素，与天族太子夜华（赵又廷）历经三生三世的情缘…

programme.title: 护心第9集
programme.desc: 灵龙天曜怀著满心喜悦准备和广寒门掌门素影成亲，谁知素影另有图谋，她计划取龙鳞制一件龙鳞铠甲，为护她真正所爱之人不伤不死，却不想天曜拼死在最后一刻将凝聚巨大灵力的护心鳞打出，素影大怒，将天曜的不死之身肢解，封印于大江南北。护心鳞飞跃山河，落入了一心口缺失的弃婴雁回胸膛，填补了雁回心脏缺失，让她得以活命。十年后，流浪的雁回被辰星山掌门凌霄收养，纳入辰星山成为他的弟子。因识海未开，灵力全无，仍是一星弟子，因此被同门嘲笑。一次偶然的机会，触发了雁回心口护心鳞的力量，灵龙之火瞬间烧毁了锁妖塔的结界，塔内的妖族趁机逃跑。凌霄得知后将其赶出辰星山，雁回误解了师父，觉得道不同不相为谋，便潇洒下山去永州成找好朋

programme.desc: 家是指一个作为个人、家庭或部落成员的居住空间，通常是房屋或其他建筑物，也可能是组合屋、营帐、船屋或洞窟。是一个可供个人或家庭在里面饮食、睡眠和储存财产的地方，也是人们寄托情感的中心。根据《世界人权宣言》第12条规定，个人的住所不允许无理的侵犯。

programme.desc: 在广告公司上班的晓潼独自生活，她的嗜好是工作，朋友寥寥无几。晓潼认为靠自己太近的人通常也是伤害自己最深的人。某天，她被告知多年未见的父亲中风昏迷，她必须照顾从未见过的七岁弟弟晓光。而这时前男友被挖角成为自己同事，这一个男孩一个男人将打乱她的生活...

programme.desc: (2016)五十年的老葬仪社就快倒了，张老板决定模仿大企业，拍支介绍影片来挽救事业，由于人手不足，他只好亲自扮演死者，但在此同时，他却得知了自己癌末的消息。命运奇妙的安排，让张老板爬进了棺材，在生命的最后一步步演练著自己的告别式。

programme.desc: 小鸥（奚伊鸥）是苏家最小的媳妇，不幸在进门前后，公公跟老公就相继挂掉，使她完全不得夫家人心。守寡的小鸥也巴不得不再跟婆家有任何牵连，但天不从人愿，命运使她跟婆婆越走越近。一天婆婆邀她回去吃中秋饭，她以为婆婆好意，没想到是要她签字放弃丈夫的寿险继承，而由买保险的婆婆受益。她气得要划清界线，结果意外发现夫家的饼舖珍贺斋即将面临关门的命运，婆婆要北上依靠三子一女度过晚年。小鸥假装事不关己，却陆续听到几个儿女像诈骗集团一样讹诈婆婆的养老金，激起她的同情心，想帮婆婆一把。落到无家可归的彩香急需帮助，但援手来自于这不得她疼的媳妇，她又拉不下脸。经由烘焙师发贵的巧妙牵引，小鸥跟彩香约定不以婆媳关系，而以事业

programme.title: 苦力第1集
programme.desc: 苦力是指从事劳动工作，以付出劳力来维生的廉价劳工。他们大多在码头负责货物的装卸、建筑地盘的运输工作。从中国出发到外国工作的苦力，历史上称之为华工。

programme.title: 行走TIT第240集
programme.desc: 台湾不只有十四族，八百部落各有特色。公视推出原乡部落行脚节目《行走TIT》，用脚、用眼、用心行走，带观众认识新台湾！首季探索十三个部落，挖掘罕为人知的部落故事。

programme.title: 恐龙女孩小丹2第7集
programme.desc: 小丹是九岁的小古生物学家，她有用不完的精力，热爱恐龙的知识胜于一切。有一天在图书馆里，她拿到崔克的恐龙图鉴，发现自己竟然能看到真正的恐龙！还保护了秃顶龙宝宝，免得被觅食的霸王龙抓走。小丹经过改造的后背包，可以让她变装成各种恐龙的样子，让恐龙误以为她也是同伴。

programme.title: 就是爱运动第23集
programme.desc: 健康是国家繁荣和个人生活的基石，而运动是保持健康的关键。因此，公共电视与教育部携手合作，策划了一个名为《就是爱运动》的节目。透过每一集的介绍，我们希望让观众更深入了解国内各项体育发展的情况，并培养对运动的热爱和支持。同时，我们也期望能够激发观众对运动的兴趣，并鼓励他们积极参与运动。

programme.title: 水果冰淇淋第2733集
programme.desc: 单元多，可创造明快的节目节奏！不同的单元，犹如一个个不一样的抽屉，彼此的区隔明确清楚。 多样的单元，各有各的教育目标及观赏乐趣。不一样的孩子可以找到自己喜欢和认同的单元。幼儿的学习并非逻辑式的。单元式的学习方式，更能符合幼儿的学习与发展。综合杂志型态的节目类型，可以针对幼儿做全方位的生活学习。

programme.title: 出外人生第17集

programme.title: Kari Snruwan纪时光第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 带你踏上充满魅力的兰屿岛，深入了解雅美（达悟）族独特的文化传统。 你知道吗？当长子诞生，父母与祖父母都必须改名，这不仅是一项命名规则，更是对家族传承的尊重与延续。节目中，我们将跟随耆老的脚步，聆听他们故事传递的生活智慧，从出海捕鱼到追踪山猪，学习在大自然中生活的哲理，一起感受随兴自然的岛屿节奏，邀你一同感受岛屿文化的纯粹与感动。

programme.title: senay345第2季:第208集
programme.desc: 一起唱出具有渲染力的文化音符，「族语童谣里述说的是我们的根」，全新型态的儿童少年节目《senay345》，将透过活泼创新的儿童音乐节目形式，提供不同族群孩童一个享受展演的舞台。每一集会邀请二位孩童，在节目中演唱族语歌曲，听著小朋友说著族语故事，透过童趣的自然对话与互动激发创作力和表达能力，一起感受到纯粹快乐自然的沉浸在族语世界里。

programme.desc: 我们去学校上课啰！ 这一季我们带著六个动画人物走进校园，去到教学阿美语、排湾语、泰雅语、布农语还有太鲁阁语的五个族群语言的学校，跟著族语老师与小小朋友们一起上课、一起唱歌，呈现俏皮与新颖的族语教学方式。在课堂中认识书写文字的发音，还有复习每集的主要单字。

programme.title: malo’loay听故事第2集

programme.title: 暗夜新闻第5集
programme.desc: 暗夜客话新闻是全国唯一主播、记者以全客语发音的新闻频道，并 详实显示字幕，除了著眼于「客家观点」的重要新闻议题、呈现客家生活 习俗与传统文化之外，更尽力发掘社会各阶层客家乡亲的故事。暗夜客话新闻针对四节新闻播出镜面，以桐花、蓝衫等各种不同主题的客家元素为基础，作全面的视觉设计，让收视大众们能够耳目一新、零时差的掌握，最具客家观点的新闻呈现。

programme.title: 女仨的婚事第3集
programme.desc: 故事从一个貌似丧礼的婚宴开始，这么奇特的想法让生性传统的女方母亲刘妈妈大为光火，她搞不懂小女儿好不容易才觅得的幸福为什么要弄成冰冷的模样，这不是在触霉头吗？原来这对新人彼此都有过婚姻的经历，这一次他们要向过去不快的婚姻告别，共同携手迎向未来。尽管刘妈妈自己的婚姻并不幸福，但她还是期盼著女儿们能拥有幸福的婚姻。深受刘妈妈影响的大女儿在婚姻路上走的并不顺遂。嗜酒的二女儿誓言非「最爱」不嫁，依旧单身的她，在婚宴上遇到那曾经被她伤害的男人带著他的家人出席。刘妈妈有名无实的丈夫竟也出现在婚礼，过往的种种一一浮现。

programme.title: 客家新闻杂志第981集
programme.desc: 由陈美祯主持，以客家人的观点，结合时事和近期举办的各种客家活动，做详尽而深入的各种专题探讨和介绍。

programme.title: 福气来了第95集

programme.title: 当昼新闻第6集
programme.desc: 《当昼新闻》是一个日间新闻节目，提供即时、全面的国内外新闻报导，涵盖政治、经济、社会、文化等多方面的重要议题。这个节目专注于在白天时段向观众传递当下最重要的新闻资讯，让观众随时掌握时事动向，并对众多议题保持关注和理解。无论是政治动荡、经济变化，或者社会事件和文化创新，这个节目都将为观众带来最及时的报导和解析。

programme.title: 大自然生趣第22集
programme.desc: 你知道台湾原生的鹿科动物总共有几种吗？你知道留鸟与夏候鸟的差别吗？你知道「南路鹰一万死九千」这句话的由来吗？你知道有哪些鸟是父亲负责孵蛋跟照顾小孩呢？ 请共下来了解，《大自然生趣》。 《大自然生趣》，照字面意思来说，是自然界中生生不息的各种生物所带来的许多趣味。很凑巧的，「生趣」这两个字，其实这是客语「有趣」的发音，因此换成客语来说，就是「大自然真有趣」。这个节目是将客籍生态纪录片导演刘燕明先生三十余年来上山下海，辛苦拍摄所得的丰富生态影像，以每集5分钟之短篇制作成有趣又具生态教育意义的短片，具有两大特色：1.生态专业团队制作：导演刘燕明先生与撰稿、旁白的邓庆煜先生，两人皆具备生态与纪录片拍

programme.title: 昆虫捉迷藏第3集
programme.desc: 我们将带您重新认识昆虫世界。昆虫是与人类最亲近的生物之一，我们曾经与它们有过亲密的接触。然而，随著年纪增长和忙碌的生活，我们可能已经遗忘了这些回忆，甚至因为对昆虫的陌生和不了解而留下了负面印象。透过重新认识一只蝴蝶幼虫，我们将带您认识叶子、花朵、树木、森林以及生命的蜕变。这将改变您对生命的看法，并激发您对自然的兴趣和

programme.title: 当昼新闻第7集
programme.desc: 《当昼新闻》是一个日间新闻节目，提供即时、全面的国内外新闻报导，涵盖政治、经济、社会、文化等多方面的重要议题。这个节目专注于在白天时段向观众传递当下最重要的新闻资讯，让观众随时掌握时事动向，并对众多议题保持关注和理解。无论是政治动荡、经济变化，或者社会事件和文化创新，这个节目都将为观众带来最及时的报导和解析。

programme.title: 大自然生趣第23集
programme.desc: 你知道台湾原生的鹿科动物总共有几种吗？你知道留鸟与夏候鸟的差别吗？你知道「南路鹰一万死九千」这句话的由来吗？你知道有哪些鸟是父亲负责孵蛋跟照顾小孩呢？ 请共下来了解，《大自然生趣》。 《大自然生趣》，照字面意思来说，是自然界中生生不息的各种生物所带来的许多趣味。很凑巧的，「生趣」这两个字，其实这是客语「有趣」的发音，因此换成客语来说，就是「大自然真有趣」。这个节目是将客籍生态纪录片导演刘燕明先生三十余年来上山下海，辛苦拍摄所得的丰富生态影像，以每集5分钟之短篇制作成有趣又具生态教育意义的短片，具有两大特色：1.生态专业团队制作：导演刘燕明先生与撰稿、旁白的邓庆煜先生，两人皆具备生态与纪录片拍

programme.title: 女仨的婚事第4集
programme.desc: 故事从一个貌似丧礼的婚宴开始，这么奇特的想法让生性传统的女方母亲刘妈妈大为光火，她搞不懂小女儿好不容易才觅得的幸福为什么要弄成冰冷的模样，这不是在触霉头吗？原来这对新人彼此都有过婚姻的经历，这一次他们要向过去不快的婚姻告别，共同携手迎向未来。尽管刘妈妈自己的婚姻并不幸福，但她还是期盼著女儿们能拥有幸福的婚姻。深受刘妈妈影响的大女儿在婚姻路上走的并不顺遂。嗜酒的二女儿誓言非「最爱」不嫁，依旧单身的她，在婚宴上遇到那曾经被她伤害的男人带著他的家人出席。刘妈妈有名无实的丈夫竟也出现在婚礼，过往的种种一一浮现。

programme.title: 回归书籍-世界的书店第11集

programme.title: 工程大改造第1集
programme.desc: 工程师被迫前进地下，快来一饱眼福，看看由他们注入生命的结构奇迹。

programme.title: 绝地伐木勇士第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 债台高筑的杰瑞德蜡烛多头烧，他在灰熊营地进行整备，伐木工却无法搭直升机前来。下游的船屋基地迁移到新地点，但野雁的出现让船屋基地的作业完全停摆。

programme.title: 旧货猎人第8季:第4集
programme.desc: 德鲁这次将前往士洛普夏的旧货商城与西约克夏的阿克沃思学校，并拜访苏佛克的军事设备收藏家。他将在堤伊的协助下，翻箱倒柜，寻找旧货。

programme.title: 仓储挖宝王第2季:第1集
programme.desc: 普雷亚维斯塔是海滩社区，居民有钱有闲，因此汤和艾伦到这里竞标仓库时，心想一定能够挖到宝。这次他们标到两间仓库。其中一间有马力十足，但非常危险而停产的酷沙滩车，不过零件四散，油箱里也有垃圾，因此他们费了点工夫加以清理组装，最后仍卖到好价钱。另一间仓库里有19世纪的压式手枪和短管手枪，那是当年赌徒爱用的枪，因为它设计成可以隐藏在手里，让赌徒对出老千的对手开枪。这两把枪历经百年，仍能顺利击发，因此也卖到好价钱。

programme.title: 仓储挖宝王第2季:第2集
programme.desc: 本集的仓储挖宝王再次前往加州托伦斯挖宝，参加四个仓库的拍卖。主持人艾伦和汤以他们犀利的眼光，立刻相中其中两座仓库——分别是海洋运动间和音乐间，然后以巧妙的手腕成功得标。得标后检视他们的战利品时，发现一些可以大赚一票的珍宝，包括有百年历史爱迪生家用留声机、90年代极受欢迎的迷你艇，以及高档鱼竿和卷线器。最后他们再以老练的手法找高价物品的买家，成功转手把得标物卖出。他们在短短的时间内，花费1725元，最后总共净赚5100元。

programme.title: 富豪谷底求翻身第1季:第8集
programme.desc: 挑战终于步入第九十天，店面装潢完毕，小卒烧烤餐厅即将正式开幕。葛伦也总算能向团队成员揭晓他的真实身分，实际答谢每个成员的辛苦付出，同时指派未来的管理干部。但首先他做出沉痛决定，让不适任的克莉丝汀卸下大厨职位，由艾胥莉和牛仔麦克接掌厨房。棠凡、麦特、阿杰等团队核心成员，则各自以努力和实力换得丰厚报酬。开幕日餐厅大排长龙，估价员也到场评估企业价值，不论小卒品牌是否达成百万目标，葛伦创立的企业已经改变许多人的人生，葛伦自己也在这段历程中获得深刻的体会与醒悟。

programme.title: 波兰边境护卫队第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 作为欧盟东部主要边界，波兰边境护卫队以敏锐观察力严格把关各个港口、铁路和车辆的出入。本集节目中，海关人员成功挡下民众试图挟带闯关的肉类制品、乳制品、药品以及藏在货车拖杆中的大量走私香烟。

programme.title: 旧矿区新财路第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 艾力克斯和凯文远赴亚利桑那州普雷斯科特附近的冰山营矿场，矿场封闭了40年，通往矿场的道路几乎不复存在，矿坑口也差不多封闭了，且土质松动，极易掉落砸伤人。因此艾力克斯和凯文协助矿场主开通道路、取得开凿与支撑矿坑口和铺设铁轨等所需工具设备，使矿场得以运作。

programme.title: 美国老屋新风情第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 本集麦克和珍买下普利普顿新月街上另一栋有三百多年历史的铁匠之家，三百多年来只有两个家族住过，房屋本身几乎没什么更动过，还保留一些最初的古老元素，要如何借由翻修来重获新生呢？

programme.title: 富豪谷底求翻身-东山再起第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 这回葛伦史登斯要重返伊利，挑战更艰难的任务：帮助小公司起死回生。过去一年来，全世界面临公卫与经济危机，而小型事业体的储备现金平均只能撑27天。葛伦要尽他所能，协助苦苦挣扎的店东在这个期限内转为获利。本集中求援的是「微醺豆咖啡厅」老板吉赛儿，葛伦设定的主要目标是转型成功，每日销量从30杯饮品提升到2百杯。

programme.title: 白令海大吸金第13季:第5集
programme.desc: 在阿拉斯加的诺姆，淘金热仍在延烧。在黄金热推波助澜下，许多迫切需要用钱的矿工拚了命，也不顾一切驾驶著破旧的挖泥船，潜进变化莫测的冰冷白令海底，全为了吸金捞一笔。

programme.title: 台湾特战部队第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 「只有海底能阻止我们潜得更深！」简单一句话即说明了海军水下作业大队的任务。作战时，支援海上渗透，协助猎雷舰执行各港口水雷清除及障碍物爆破等工作。平时则负责处理水中械弹、水下船体检查与修补、清除港湾障碍物等深海水域工作，风灾后也常看见水下作业大队参与救灾的身影，保卫著人民的生命安全；2010年台风催毁苏花公路，造成游览车翻覆，车上游客全数掉进太平洋罹难，当时在危险的海域与恶劣的天候情况进行海底搜救任务的就是海军水下作业大队。与一般海军不同，除了必须深谙水性、熟悉机械与救难知识外，更重要的是学习如何在海底面对水下的各种危险与险恶环境，安全地执行任务。12周的训练中，队员们需接受踩水、潜泳、水肺及1

programme.title: 星厨飨港
programme.desc: 在充满活力的香港，来自世界各地的米其林星级主厨，分享他们在香港的烹饪经验与对本地的感受，并且展望未来的发展。

programme.title: 绝地伐木勇士第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 负债累累的杰瑞德遇到野雁在滑橇坡下蛋筑巢，导致木材无法顺利下水，灰熊营地也因为天气不佳，迟迟无法开始动工，情况雪上加霜。

programme.title: 蛋白石猎人越野去第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 杰西卡鲁汪那将跟著老师罗德曼宁闯遍澳洲，踏上一场为期12周的学习之旅，好为接下来的创业做准备，也希望这次能在旅行结束前每人赚到1万澳元。

programme.title: 旧货猎人第20季:第1集
programme.desc: 德鲁普里察是个现代的寻宝人。面对挑剔的客户和高流通率，拥有英国最大的装饰艺品回收场，德鲁经常前往英国各地寻找被人遗弃的珍宝和古物。德鲁喜欢寻宝的刺激，他在缺乏建筑美学的地方大肆搜刮，再带回店里请他的菁英修复团队为这些古老珍宝赋予新生

programme.title: 仓储挖宝王第2季:第3集
programme.desc: 艾伦和汤要去西洛杉矶，这里有玩滑板,冲浪,赶时髦的人，最重要的是还有很多有钱人。他们起了个大早来拍卖竞标却没看到值得买的仓库，却在一周前买的海运货柜发现可能让他们坐拥金矿的机车零件。

programme.title: 仓储挖宝王第2季:第4集
programme.desc: 艾伦和汤来到佛罗里达罗德岱堡，这里以悠闲,奢华和闲钱多闻名。在地竞标人憎恶外地人试著要从他们的拍卖中获利，他们在跟当地人闲聊探听敌情时，发现当地人提醒他们要留意吉马这个人。

programme.title: 姜成镐狂野时速第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 姜成镐此次韩国之行，既是探寻韩国的汽车文化，也是寻根和与母亲和解之旅。

programme.title: 台湾特战部队第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 仿效美国陆军游骑兵学校而创立的陆军突击干部训练班，网罗来自陆军各部队想要成为菁英中菁英的挑战者，训练如何面对原始丛林、险峻高山等恶劣环境，替正规军创造有利的时空条件发起攻击，他们的特性是飘忽、捉摸不定地于敌人后方进行袭扰、爆破，可谓是战争急先锋。突击干部训练须学习如何克服各种困难地形与障碍，在体力极度消耗的状况下，保持冷静的领导能力达成渗透、侦查等任务，一千公尺障碍、垂降、水中逃生与山地战技训练都是家常便饭。训练严苛艰辛，仅有不到三分之一学员可以安然完成结训。

programme.title: 波兰边境护卫队第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 波兰边境护卫队在陆路与港口的边境管制站守候国境安全，破获旅客装傻或谎称是礼物而企图夹带入境的管制物品，以及以T恤作为烟雾弹掩护的大型香烟走私货柜。

programme.title: 富豪谷底求翻身-东山再起第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 这回葛伦史登斯要重返伊利，挑战更艰难的任务：帮助小公司起死回生。过去一年来，全世界面临公卫与经济危机，而小型事业体的储备现金平均只能撑27天。葛伦要尽他所能，协助苦苦挣扎的店东在这个期限内转为获利。本集中求援的是「微醺豆咖啡厅」老板吉赛儿，葛伦设定的主要目标是转型成功，每日销量从30杯饮品提升到2百杯。

programme.title: 监控追缉线第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 全美各地，警方和地方社区有新武器来对抗犯罪，即时犯罪中心使用监视器、追踪系统和枪声侦测器来破案，将坏人绳之以法。一起看监控追缉的故事吧。

programme.title: 富豪谷底求翻身-东山再起第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 投入于经营非营利事业的麦可拥有一家汽车美容厂，麦可的身世背景让他决定买下一栋旧屋，改装厨房，并在那里准备餐点喂饱数千名孩童，再整理出空房间，供戒毒者或刚出狱者短暂居住，直到他们能重新振作。只是为凑得达成梦想所需的资金，他得先把汽车美容生意做起来、先启用厨房做外卖餐盒，再与知名基金会合作以取得可信度与税收减免。伊利善心人士麦可在27天后，能否如愿朝梦想更进一步呢？

programme.title: 翻新中古车第14季:第5集
programme.desc: 本集翻新中古车将处理一台1994年出厂的三菱3000G VR4。车况虽然良好，重要的主动系统却纷纷发生故障，安特不免怀疑这次翻新，很有可能所费不赀。

programme.title: 卡车世家第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 在市值数十亿美元的客制化卡车产业，佛罗里达州的启示录车厂是最顶尖的存在，专门打造最强悍、最狂野的卡车，征服广大粉丝，客户包括盖法耶瑞、侠客欧尼尔、脱口秀大哥大杰雷诺和NBA超级球星卢卡东契奇等名人。对老板老乔和艾希莉来说，设计、制造并销售这些不可思议的卡车，需要一支不惜一切达成目标的团队。但当你的员工就像怪咖家族的时候，事情往往变得意想不到的混乱。

programme.title: 绝地伐木勇士第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 在两处营地来回奔波，背负莫大压力的杰瑞德财务状况岌岌可危。

programme.title: 用鱼叉猎黑鲔第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 杀谋号的乔和奈森带孩子上船，让他们了解鱼叉捕鱼的工作。松棺号的狄伦船长则是让儿子小艾初次担任鱼叉手，让下个世代从做中学。

programme.title: 旧货猎人第8季:第5集
programme.desc: 德鲁这次将前往士洛普夏边界的老院旧物行，普拉斯迪南的古老庄园和白金汉郡的奇尔屯露天博物馆。他将在堤伊的协助下，翻箱倒柜，寻找旧货。

programme.title: 旧货猎人修复篇-世界大战特集
programme.desc: 旧货猎人修复篇-世界大战特集

programme.title: 金帝手工车厂第10季:第18集
programme.desc: 一辆1955年雪佛兰贝埃尔与一辆2002年法拉利360敞篷版在金帝手工车厂获得了新生命。

programme.title: 超狂抢案第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 阿根廷在2001年爆发经济危机，许多人失去毕生积蓄，艺术家阿劳霍萌生了抢银行的念头，找来童年老友及技术专家，费时三年拟定一桩打劫富人区银行的瞒天大计。

programme.title: 印度婚纱好生意第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 昌登时尚面对社区变迁和客户流失，于是计划在周末到西区开设一个快闪店以吸引更多客户。

programme.title: 印度婚纱好生意第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 昌登希望能开第二间店，但面临著大楼维修问题。维修费用高达十万元，这让开新店的计划变得更加困难。

programme.title: 我的男友是妈宝第4季:第2集
programme.desc: 萨席第一次带女友奈拉回家过感恩节，她的穿著引起其家人不满，又提及打算与萨席同居，让场面十分尴尬。希望尽早抱孙的凯莉帮麦特安排联谊找新女友。

programme.title: 爱在垦荒时第2季:第5集
programme.desc: 玛依莎的妈妈造访农庄，并质问了这对情侣的多重伴侣关系。

programme.title: 我的梦幻婚纱第20季:第5集
programme.desc: 本集节目中，婚纱顾问团队要协助即将步入礼堂的新娘寻找梦想中的婚纱。莫妮克身材娇小，但她想找气势非凡，有女王派头的蓬裙婚纱。萝伦品味卓绝，除了前卫又时尚的婚纱，她都看不上眼。她们能如愿以偿，顺利穿上心目中的梦幻婚纱吗？

programme.title: 脚病诊所第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 里欧娜以前天天都要穿十二小时的高跟鞋，脚长了好几颗巨大的鸡眼，寸步难行。席亚患有罕见的斑色鱼鳞癣，脚掌也因此堆叠了超多硬梆梆的厚皮。

programme.title: 杨升德来点菜第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 杨升德前往德州休士顿向名厨讨教料理技巧。他先在「血盟兄弟」学习烟熏，再到「宁法去航行」学习明火炙烧。最后是到主打越式料理的「你好餐厅」学习使用镬。

programme.title: 爱在垦荒时第2季:第5集
programme.desc: 玛依莎的妈妈造访农庄，并质问了这对情侣的多重伴侣关系。

programme.title: 我的男友是妈宝第4季:第2集
programme.desc: 萨席第一次带女友奈拉回家过感恩节，她的穿著引起其家人不满，又提及打算与萨席同居，让场面十分尴尬。希望尽早抱孙的凯莉帮麦特安排联谊找新女友。

programme.title: 到美国结婚去-寻爱再出击第1季:第9集
programme.desc: 伊莉丝逼问珍妮佛和科尔之间绘声绘影的流言。蒂芙尼被推到风口浪尖，而香黛儿可不会就这样算了。

programme.title: 我的梦幻婚纱第16季:第2集
programme.desc: 双胞胎玛歌跟玛萝又回到克莱菲尔婚纱店，这次他们要帮玛萝挑婚纱，玛萝拜托蓝迪跟丽莎，跟她一起把怀孕四个月的消息告知家人，但玛歌却恶意批评玛萝穿上婚纱后明显的孕肚；薇儿是乳癌的癌友，她跟未婚夫决定在冰川上结婚，婚期就在三周后，因时间紧迫，他们只能挑内店现有的婚纱，但薇儿的挑剔让挑选婚纱的过程变得更困难。

programme.title: 到国外征婚去第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 本集节目中，三位美国人苏珊、哈洛德与丝丹妮卡在美国一直没能找到真爱，也不想透过冷冰冰的交友软体找对象，把自己的未来伴侣局限在美国。

programme.title: 小气家族第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 住在美国奥兰多市的陈家人是疯狂亚洲小气鬼，全家人最爱到路边捡别人丢弃的物品，拿回家里的车库收著，等需要时再拿出来改造利用。这次他们捡了门回来，做成伸展台让女儿练习选美比赛走台步。贝琪盖尔想要整修旧房子，把墙面打掉，但是她竟然异想天开想要自己打掉墙面，而别人建议她去请专家看那是不是承重墙，她却笑称没有承重墙这回事，不用花这个钱。雪莉瓦森的二女儿要结婚，但她却只想拿大女儿的婚纱来修改，让二女儿相当无奈。

programme.title: 爱在垦荒时第2季:第6集
programme.desc: 超级风暴来袭，珍的儿子面临危险，她与查理的关系也陷入危机。

programme.title: 阿贤亚洲好食光第1季:第4集

programme.title: 低价丑屋变好宅第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 克莉丝蒂李Cristy Lee协助心灰意冷的购屋族，找出价格令人惊喜的的潜力物件，缺点就是屋况通常满恐怖的。但只要他们愿意相信克莉丝蒂刻划的愿景，她就能把最糟糕的房子改造成他们梦想中的家。

programme.title: 印度婚纱好生意第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 昌登时尚面对社区变迁和客户流失，于是计划在周末到西区开设一个快闪店以吸引更多客户。

programme.title: 印度婚纱好生意第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 昌登希望能开第二间店，但面临著大楼维修问题。维修费用高达十万元，这让开新店的计划变得更加困难。

programme.title: 宠物101第2季:第1集
programme.desc: 宠物的世界不只有猫狗而已。几百万户的家庭把毛茸茸、身上有羽毛或鳞片的奇特动物带进家门当宠物。这群受人疼爱的宠物各有不同，有的温暖、多毛、多话，有的则优雅、好奇或惹人怜爱。牠们有的喜欢赖在家里、有的则是爱待在池子内，还有一些整天在笼子里踩著滚轮跑。《宠物101》每集节目将介绍6种不同的宠物，带你了解每种宠物和特点，还有来自养殖专家、培训师以及兽医的建议，为想要拥有可爱宠物，却不知该如何选择的观众提供最佳参考指标。

programme.title: 野性拉丁美洲第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 巴塔哥尼亚地区是一片神秘的原始荒野，最令人印象深刻的自然奇观在这里应有尽有。每到南半球的春季，各种动物军团都会在巴塔哥尼亚沿岸登陆，首先大批出现的是麦哲伦企鹅军团，牠们来到这片海滩筑巢育幼，甚至会为了最好的巢穴大打出手。除了娇小的企鹅，巨无霸的象鼻海豹也不会错过这个滩头，当家公海豹要趁这两个月赶紧繁衍后代，否则等于白活了。距离岸边远一点的地方也有大型草食动物的踪迹，原驼看起来不担心岸边两栖部队的攻势，但牠其实也要扛起带领整个群体的责任。这些动物大规模涌来巴塔哥尼亚地区的沿岸，全是为了繁衍后代，也因此造就了巴塔哥尼亚的奇景。

programme.title: 圣地牙哥动物园第2季:第4集
programme.desc: 在本集节目中，保育员要对两只隼进行引诱飞行，让牠们活动筋骨、动动脑袋。罕见的黑头巨蝮是南北美洲体型最大的毒蛇，蛇妈妈即将再度产下宝宝，为繁殖尽一份心力。而高龄十一岁的猎豹左前脚似乎不太舒服，一直踮脚走路，保育员因此为牠进行精密的健康检查，希望能找出原因。

programme.desc: 巴塔哥尼亚地区是一片神秘的原始荒野，最令人印象深刻的自然奇观在这里应有尽有。每到南半球的春季，各种动物军团都会在巴塔哥尼亚沿岸登陆，首先大批出现的是麦哲伦企鹅军团，牠们来到这片海滩筑巢育幼，甚至会为了最好的巢穴大打出手。除了娇小的企鹅，巨无霸的象鼻海豹也不会错过这个滩头，当家公海豹要趁这两个月赶紧繁衍后代，否则等于白活了。距离岸边远一点的地方也有大型草食动物的踪迹，原驼看起来不担心岸边两栖部队的攻势，但牠其实也要扛起带领整个群体的责任。这些动物大规模涌来巴塔哥尼亚地区的沿岸，全是为了繁衍后代，也因此造就了巴塔哥尼亚的奇景。

programme.title: 百变水族箱第7季:第4集
programme.desc: 在本集百变水族箱中，主持人要替电影人兼谐星凯文史密斯制作一个水陆两用箱，让他所饲养的水龟与陆龟能换个新家。他们除了将水龟与陆龟住的地方合并起之外，还在水族箱中加进美丽的锦鲤，替凯文史密斯家增添新气象。

programme.title: 圣地牙哥动物园第2季:第5集
programme.desc: 在本集节目中，园区第一只人工抚养的南方白犀牛宝宝即将认识其他犀牛，学习群体生活。马来亚虎康纳不停流鼻血，但原因不明，保育员让牠接受电脑断层检查，希望能找出原因。两只公无尾熊宝宝即将变成室友，但地域性很强的牠们能和平共处吗？

programme.title: 动物求生之道第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 《动物求生之道》将带您深入动物王国，揭开各种野生动物在极端环境中生存的巧妙技巧。

programme.title: 宠物101第2季:第2集
programme.desc: 宠物的世界不只有猫狗而已。几百万户的家庭把毛茸茸、身上有羽毛或鳞片的奇特动物带进家门当宠物。这群受人疼爱的宠物各有不同，有的温暖、多毛、多话，有的则优雅、好奇或惹人怜爱。牠们有的喜欢赖在家里、有的则是爱待在池子内，还有一些整天在笼子里踩著滚轮跑。《宠物101》每集节目将介绍6种不同的宠物，带你了解每种宠物和特点，还有来自养殖专家、培训师以及兽医的建议，为想要拥有可爱宠物，却不知该如何选择的观众提供最佳参考指标。

programme.title: 失落动物再发现第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 有著一对超长犬齿的斯剑虎，可谓冰河时期最可怕的野兽，然而在拉布雷亚沥青坑却出现大量斯剑虎的骨骸，本该所向无敌的掠食者为何大量死亡？牠们又为何在前次冰河时期尾声，也就是一万年前左右绝迹？把牠们送上顶级掠食者宝座的凶狠尖牙，为何也送牠们走上灭绝之路？除了冰河时期发生的气候变迁，人类是否也跟牠们的灭绝有关？

programme.title: 百变水族箱第7季:第5集
programme.desc: 泰大乐演唱、谱写及制作饶舌乐，获奖无数，包括全美音乐奖及MTV音乐录影带大奖。他请压克力水族箱公司帮他在加州长滩的家里打造一座淡水水族箱，大老粗闲暇时当舞曲播音师，很喜欢泰大乐，所以韦德和布瑞带他一起去会客。一行人参观完泰大乐的家后，决定打造两面水族箱，一边圆弧，一边加框。鱼群以非洲丽鱼为主，由于丽鱼需要较高的酸碱值，因此必须精选放入箱内的砂砾和石块。箱内造景则搭配他家现有的真石，外加重要奖座的复制品做为摆饰。

programme.title: 超能动物第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 动物界有些古怪奇特的成员，像是眼睛奇特的变色龙、鼻子超大的长鼻猴、红唇饱满的达氏蝙蝠鱼，还有再生能力超强的墨西哥钝口螈。

programme.title: 圣地牙哥动物园第2季:第6集
programme.desc: 圣地牙哥野生动物园的母丛林袋鼠席玛生下有白化症的埃佛勒斯，园方决定让母子搬去野生动物工作坊成为动物大使，教导民众认识丛林袋鼠，也认识白化症。爬虫馆内来自婆罗洲的极危种西瓜龟在沙滩产卵了，顺利在孵化室内孵出园区的第一窝小西瓜龟。园方要替产自东南亚的六岁渔猫史都华打造新栖架，让牠有更多自在活动空间。野生动物园区的小红鹳因为受到附近猫头鹰偷食幼鸟而繁殖效果不佳，园方首次尝试让大红鹳帮忙孵化,养育小红鹳，成效不错。树懒大使洁娜在园方不知情的情况下怀孕并产下宝宝，带来许多惊喜。

programme.title: 百变水族箱第7季:第6集
programme.desc: 摇滚巨星艾许巴在赌城云霄塔的服饰店面即将开幕，因此他再次找上韦德和布瑞，请他们为店内打造一座摇滚风的圆柱形水族箱。由于开幕时间迫在眉睫，韦德和布瑞采用现成的压克力高压舱改造成水族箱，借此缩短制作时间。造景部分则使用艾许巴指定的骷髅头作为主题，搭配熔岩色仿造石材，营造出末日与生机并存的氛围。艾许巴的另一个要求，则是在水族箱里养鲨鱼。考量到空间限制，海瑟和艾格妮丝选择了小巧可爱的斑猫鲨，搭配各式各样色彩缤纷的海水鱼，让水族箱成为店里最吸睛的焦点。

programme.title: 野性澳大利亚第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 《野性澳大利亚》是一部探索澳大利亚大自然和野生动物的纪录片。介绍澳大利亚各地的自然景观、动植物种类和它们的生态习性。这部纪录片以生动的摄影和有趣的故事，让观众更加认识这个美丽而多样的国家。

programme.title: 动物求生高手第2季:第5集
programme.desc: 揭晓自然界的伪装高手，从微型刺客到顶级掠食者，全都是奇特的生物，展现出不可思议的力量。

programme.title: 灭绝动物大追踪第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 野生生物学佛瑞斯特葛兰特，专门寻找人类已经放弃的动物，这次他来到加拿大纽芬兰寻找纽芬兰白狼。纽芬兰白狼在87年前被宣告绝迹，但最近不但有人目睹而且还枪杀了一只，因此佛瑞斯特来到纽芬兰，协同狼行为专家查尔斯博格博士，一起深入山区，寻找传说中的纽芬兰白狼。

programme.title: 野生动物求生录第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 繁殖是最接近永生不朽的事，透过求偶和交配，动物才得以延续自身物种。

programme.title: 汪汪队之小砾与工程家族第1季:第124集
programme.desc: 《汪汪队立大功》是加拿大电脑成像儿童动画影集，内容叙述由一位热心、精通科技丶聪明，名叫莱德的11岁小孩带领的小狗巡逻队，共同保护一个名为冒险湾的海岸城市的故事。

programme.title: 汪汪队之小砾与工程家族第3季:第301集
programme.desc: 跟随小砾和他的建筑商家族在新城镇创办自己的建筑公司。无论是建造机场跑道还是为新餐厅挖掘场地，小砾和他的团队都能完成任务！

programme.title: Dora第3季:第301集

programme.title: 宝贝乐一通第14集
programme.desc: 在成为叛逆无礼的经典乐一通动画短片前，兔宝宝、太菲鸭和死党们都还是刚学走路的小小孩，天真无邪的好奇宝宝。 特别为学龄前儿童设计的宝贝乐一通将为卡通迷们隆重介绍这些可爱讨喜的小小明星；节目将以较小体型、甜蜜讨喜的方式呈现无比欢乐的经典卡通明星。兔宝宝、太菲鸭、傻大鸟、崔弟和大嘴怪在老婆婆充满冒险行动的维多利亚式宅第中，可是一群鬼灵精怪的小捣蛋鬼。 小兔宝宝和朋友们将邀请所有小小卡通迷，探索这个无奇不有的欢乐世界。

programme.title: 豆豆先生第59集
programme.desc: 在大小银幕上扮演豆豆先生的罗文亚特金(Rowan Atkinson)，这次将自己变身为卡通人物，并为这部动画亲自配音！本系列忠实呈现豆豆先生这个活在真实世界的角色，每一集中，我们不幸的豆豆先生，总要大费周章弄得灰头土脸，才能完成一件简单的小事，那包括找停车位、让邻居安静下来、换沙发或是晒晒太阳等。豆豆先生忠实的搭档泰迪和邪恶的房东卫奇太太，以及她的独眼猫史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾玛也同台演出。这部卡通影集已经在全球150个国家播出，曾经荣获过国际艾美奖和蒙特娄金玫瑰奖的肯定，并引起豆豆先生的热潮，改编成同名电影上映。
